test_objective: Check that the queried entities by id can be returned in GeoJSON format

test_cases.name: 019_05_01 Get an entity by id that can be returned in GeoJSON format
test_cases.doc: Check that the queried entities by id can be returned in GeoJSON format
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response containing:
        Check Response Body Content and
    Query Parameter: expectation_filename set to 'expectation_filename' and
    Query Parameter: response_body set to 'response.json()' and
    Query Parameter: additional_ignored_path set to '${EMPTY}' and
        Response Status Code set to 200
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entities Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_ids set to '${entities_ids_to_be_retrieved}' and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${entity_types_to_be_retrieved}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/geo+json' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
